generations.prompt: A young white woman in her early 20s with fair skin, slim build, and shoulder-length wavy brown hair stands gracefully at a tall library window. Warm golden hour sunlight streams through the glass, casting soft, honeyed light across her face and creating a gentle glow on her features. She gazes thoughtfully outside with a serene, contemplative expression, her body positioned at a slight three-quarter angle to the camera. The camera holds a medium shot, slowly pushing in with subtle dolly movement to create intimacy. Behind her, tall bookshelves filled with volumes are softly blurred, bathed in the same warm golden light. Dust motes dance gently in the sunbeams. The lighting is cinematic with rich golden tones, soft shadows, and a dreamy quality. Shot in 9:16 vertical aspect ratio with shallow depth of field, creating a peaceful, introspective atmosphere.
